clauses.clause: Riot infected: frontal MG hits visibly chip HP + recoil at every range incl. point blank; frontal MG kill ≤ 6 s (measured 3.7 s), flank ≤ 2 s; health bar always shown; one riot cop alone does not down a full-HP player that keeps firing (tune). PO: "I feel I have zero effect when I shoot them."
clauses.note: All requested objective measurements now fresh; P is ONLY the PO decision about whether shooting feels effective. Native frontalMG225→0 in2.183s/21hits and flank1.783s/17hits both tiers. Mortal isolated live-AI MG duels at0.9,1.6,3,6,20,26m finish in1.733,2.15,2.15,2.183,2.85,4.7s; full100HP courier survives (78HP pointblank,100HP other ranges). Physical browser pointblank mouse duels both tiers finish1.75s/17hits, player78HP, riot0HP; first hit at tick9 visibly shortens bar225→211 (fraction0.937778), settled corpse has no live bar. Actual hit reaction exists but lasts only one tick: started9,until10; production interpolation weight0.801749 at render9.5,0 at integer9/10. PO must judge perceptibility of this16.7ms recoil; observed before/first-hit pose change also includes attack motion, so it is not proof of strong hit feedback. Actual16.000m L4-map isolated riot225HP displays64×8px red/white bar at screenx≈153.5,y6 in both tiers; body and bar visible at upperleft. All8 original1280×720 cited images opened (two16m plus six duel views). Controlled16m fixture releases other infected, hides unrelated actors and positions courier/riot; duel has no God mode or AI disable. No unmeasured clause is parked under P. Additional causal render comparison: at actual worldtick10/render9.3, production flinch weight1 versus0 with only the presentation reaction temporarily omitted. All four original comparison frames opened: riot head/upper body bends back, shield and arms change pose; measured head-joint shift0.18820m low/0.18924m high, torso0.040m. World, input, attack pose and HP are otherwise held identical, and the reaction is restored immediately. This establishes a visible recoil pose; its one-tick duration and perceived strength remain the PO taste decision. Total12 cited captures inspected.
